$comment: TEST FIXTURE — the authorization boundary for the LOCAL FORK harness only.
allowBroadcast is TRUE here, which in any other file would be the moment a creator authorizes
an autonomous launch. It is safe in this one and only because the harness refuses to send
anything to an endpoint it has not proven is a loopback anvil node: `assertLocalAnvil` runs
before every state-changing RPC, and a non-loopback URL is a hard exit rather than a warning.
creatorRecipient is a synthetic TEST-ONLY address and nobody holds a key for it. It is
deliberately NOT one of anvil's default accounts: those have published keys, and an address
whose key is public is the worst possible thing for someone to copy out of a fixture into a
real launch — the creator fee stream and the ProjectRights NFT go where this field says.
It is a RECIPIENT rather than a signer. The wallet that pays for a launch and the wallet that
receives the creator fee stream are different roles, and this fixture keeps them different so
the harness proves the distinction rather than collapsing it: the signer is generated per run
and this address never signs anything.
maxNativeSpendWei is 0 on purpose. `launch` is not payable in any lane this harness uses, so a
